meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 当主持人,把你的各个 git worktree(和选中的 PR)当作独立代理拉进一个共享 Markdown 房间,逐轮比对改动,最后产出并翻译一份「合并成一个 worktree」的方案。
howto.when: 当你要对比多个 worktree、分支或 PR 的改动,想定下合并目标与顺序时触发;候选只有 0 或 1 个时它会说这不算 standup 并停下。

say.text: 给最近 24 小时有改动的 worktree 开个 standup
say.note: 会列出候选并让你确认名单

say.text: 把这几个分支和开着的 PR 拉进房间对一下
say.note: 房间只做决定,不改动或合并代码

say.text: 用大白话把房间的结论讲给我听
say.note: 输出各分支状态、合并顺序和待你定的选择

howto.what_en: Claude acts as facilitator: each of your git worktrees (and chosen PRs) joins a shared markdown room as its own agent, rounds are run to compare changes, and it produces and translates one consolidation plan.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to compare changes across git worktrees, branches, or PRs and settle a merge target and order. With zero or one candidate it says this isn't a standup and stops.

say_en.text: Run a standup for worktrees changed in the last 24 hours
say_en.note: Lists candidates and confirms the roster

say_en.text: Bring these branches and open PRs into one room
say_en.note: The room only decides; no code is merged

say_en.text: Explain the room's outcome to me in plain words
say_en.note: Gives branch states, merge order and your open calls
